Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and the learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by applicant for quashing theorder dated 14.9.2022 passed by District Judge, Sant Kabir Nagar in Sessions Trial No.0194 of 2017, State Vs.
Vinod Kumar and others, arising out of Case Crime No.909 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Dharamsinghwa, District Sant Kabir Nagar.

entities.text:
State Vs.
Vinod Kumar and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is the husband and his wife has died under unnatural circumstances.

He submits that the applicant had submitted a mobile recording of the wife prior to her death,
which indicates towards the innocence of the applicant.
However, the aforesaid mobile recording has not been accepted by the court concerned as an evidence on the ground that the original device is not available.
The court concerned ought to have considered the aforesaid recording in the evidence.

On a pointed query being made to the learned counsel for the applicant as to the law under which Vinod Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66514310/

sentences.text: without the original device the mobile recording can be considered, learned counsel for the applicant has not been able to show any law in this respect.
The application lacks merit and is, accordingly, dismissed.
